title: SPM program (program.json, editor format)
description: The flowcharts of a project as the studio draws them (Software implementation › 4c): flows per station, their nodes with position and parameters, and the links. Tags are used by NAME. The compiler (step 29) turns this into program.rt.json for the runtime. Flow rules (one Start, links, tags exist …) are checked by flow.rules.ts, not by this schema.

name.description: letters, digits and _; starts with a letter or _ (also a C identifier)
unique in the project, e.g. S1_Main

station.description: the station it belongs to (a tag scope, e.g. S1)

autostart.description: started by the runtime when the machine goes to Auto

id.description: unique in its flow; the compiler keeps it as 'src' so the screens can show the live step

type.description: node type = op of the step table in lower case (Software implementation › 4a); more types join with their steps

pos.description: [x, y] on the canvas, in canvas pixels

p.description: parameters of the type (e.g. wait_di: tag, value, timeout_ms, alarm) — checked by the editor and the compiler

name.description: optional step name shown instead of the type title

edge.description: [from node id, to node id] or, out of a Decision, [from, to, 'yes' | 'no'] (the way out is checked when the editor reads the file)
